name: ase
tagline_zh: 当AI能自己写代码、跑测试、修bug，你只需说需求。它像资深工程师，但24小时在线，还不抱怨需求变更。
tagline_en: AI writes, tests, and fixes code on its own. You just describe the need. Like a senior dev, but 24/7 and never.
why_zh: 同类工具多停留在代码生成，它却覆盖从需求到交付的完整闭环，且能自主迭代修复。
why_en: Unlike code-gen tools, it closes the loop from spec to shipped code, autonomously iterating and fixing issues.
